entities.name: Tiansun
entities.description: Eastern mountain range of Tarkir with lakes and rivers, territory of the Jeskai Way and formerly the Ojutai brood.

entities.name: Jeskai Way
entities.description: Clan holding Tiansun, bordering Mardu and Temur lands.

entities.name: Cori Mountain Monastery
entities.description: Red-aligned monastery in a flooded volcanic caldera.

entities.name: Dirgur Lake Monastery
entities.description: Blue-aligned monastery on a floating island, closest Jeskai location to the Salt Road.

entities.name: Highspire Monastery
entities.description: Mountaintop monastery where giant mantises and their caretakers reside.

entities.name: Riverwheel Village
entities.description: Cliffside settlement slowly rebuilding the former Ojutai sanctuary.

entities.name: Storm Crane Monastery
entities.description: White-aligned monastery that is a skyship built from the old Sage-Eye sanctuary; led by Narset.

entities.name: Qadat, the Fire Rim
entities.description: Volcanic region on the northern border of Jeskai territory, home to yeti.

entities.name: Purugir
entities.description: Ojutai clan's largest trading post along the Salt Road in the original timeline.

events.summary: The Sage-Eye sanctuary is destroyed in the Phyrexian invasion; its remains become Storm Crane Monastery.
events.quote: Built from the remains of the old Sage-Eye sanctuary that was destroyed in the Phyrexian invasion

events.summary: Citizens of Riverwheel Village rebuild the former Ojutai sanctuary as the ice begins to melt.
events.quote: The citizens have been slowly rebuilding the former Ojutai sanctuary

relations.quote: are the territory of the Jeskai Way
